dedupe_keys.name: tableau de tri du service de la navigation fluviale

description: Tableau de tri du Service de la navigation fluviale is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Archives nationales de Luxembourg. Sorting table of the Inland Navigation Service based on the Arcateg™ reference system. Agreement written in French and signed by hand on 09/11/2021 by the Director of the SNF and the Director of the ANLux. Administrative history: The need to create a river navigation service appeared in the 1960s as infrastructure developed on the Moselle. Coverage: Archives nationales de Luxembourg. The portal shows the English title as "River Navigation Service sorting table" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Archives nationales de Luxembourg. Its keywords include conservation, tableau-de-tri, anlux, moselle, service-de-la-navigation-fluviale, navigation-fluviale. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
